variants.style: Claymorphism: soft 3D inflated shapes, pastel shading, rounded everything
variants.typography: Geometric sans display with a humanist serif body

agentSummary: This week's design implements a dark-mode Claymorphism aesthetic by combining a soft, inflated 3D visual language with a high-contrast "Amber phosphor" palette on near-black backgrounds. The layout is structured as a centered, document-like narrow column, creating a highly focused reading experience. Typography adheres strictly to the two-font-size constraint using system geometric sans-serifs for punchy display headings and humanist serifs for readable body copy. Interactive elements feature mechanical, stepped transitions that simulate discrete tactile feedback, completing the unique blend of soft 3D shapes with sharp, terminal-like colors.
